title: A remote NotificationSpec.snoozedUntil/.offsetMinutes in-place edit is invisible to RemoteChangeReconciler's diff (latent, not reachable today)

description: Flagged as deliberate tracked debt in 4b's own plan doc (docs/superpowers/plans/2026-07-28-plan-4b-notification-truthfulness.md, Scope note under X9 + the 'Discovered, out-of-scope residual' section): RemoteChangeReconciler.affectedTaskIDs widens to NotificationSpec inserts and the existing lastFiredAt update, but deliberately NOT to an arbitrary remote snoozedUntil/offsetMinutes edit on an EXISTING spec row (same-spec, in-place update, changeType == .update on a pre-existing objectID). Confirmed via grep during 4b that NotificationSpecStore.update has exactly one production caller (handleSnoozeAction, same-device only) and no UI path edits an existing spec's offsetMinutes in place -- reminders are create-or-delete, never edited in place. This is a LATENT gap, not currently reachable in production. Not fixed during the 6a completeness sweep: fixing an unreachable path now would add untested, unexercised defensive code for a scenario nothing can trigger (YAGNI) -- correctly deferred, per 4b's own reasoning, to whichever future plan actually adds a cross-device spec-edit UI path (e.g. a cross-device snooze feature) and touches NotificationSpecStore.update's callers. Redesign trigger: any new caller of NotificationSpecStore.update reachable from a different device/process than the one that created the spec.
